profile.headline: Embedded System Software Engineer at Centrus Energy Corp.
profile.summary:
Passionate about the intersection of technology and innovation. Throughout my academic journey, I have immersed myself in a diverse range of projects, from interning in the power industry to programming microcontrollers. This and many other roles have given me quite a range of knowlege in the different sectors Electrical Engineering can involve.

My fascination with robotics and microprocessors has driven me to explore the dynamic interplay between hardware and software, constantly seeking opportunities to apply theoretical knowledge to real-world solutions. Whether it's optimizing circuit designs for efficiency or troubleshooting the mix of software algorithms or optimizing hardware solutions I strive to accomplish enhanced performance, I thrive on the challenge of creating impactful solutions in rapidly evolving technological landscapes.

With a strong foundation in electrical engineering principles and a knack for problem-solving, I am eager to leverage my skills to tackle complex challenges and drive innovation in any industry. I am particularly drawn to opportunities in research and development that allow me to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, bringing together diverse perspectives to develop cutting-edge technologies that shape the future.

As I embark on the next chapter of my career journey, I am excited to explore new opportunities where I can contribute my passion, creativity, and technical expertise to make a meaningful difference. I would like to push the boundaries of the knowledge I have and grow as a person and professional in industry. Let's connect and explore how we can collaborate to push the boundaries of what's possible in electrical and computer engineering.
